I love how folks who've never been to Iran are lecturing me, someone who grew up in Tehran and has an American father, about how Iranians feel about Americans.

Even the American journalists who cover pro-regime rallies are greeted with, "Ve love Amreeka, just not your gov't!"

As some Iranians rightly point out, this is technically not a joke. Iranians are some of the most hospitable people in the world, and they would actually feed an American pilot and take care of him/her.

There's commentary in the US media rn about whether the Iranian population would be "hostile" to the US pilots. 

I find that absurd, given that Iranians are arguably the most pro-American in the Middle East. There's a 7 out of 9 chance they'd be met with hospitality.
